data.title: Blue Jays unsurprisingly predicted to let 3.31 ERA Cy Young leave in free agency - Sporting News
data.content: # Blue Jays unsurprisingly predicted to let 3.31 ERA Cy Young leave in free agency. After a wildly disappointing 2026 season, the Toronto Blue Jays may make notable roster adjustments this offseason. Max Scherzer and Shane Bieber reach free agency this winter, and Bleacher Report's Joel Reuter predicts that Toronto will let Bieber walk. He made just 11 starts before shoulder inflammation ended his season at the end of August, but he had a 2.59 ERA over 24.1 innings in his final four starts before hitting the shelf," Reuter wrote. Injuries have limited Bieber to just 96 innings since last year's trade deadline with the Blue Jays. "At 31 years old, he represents a quality buy-low target, but the Blue Jays might be hunting for more stability as they rebuild their staff," Reuter added. It may be best for the Blue Jays to look for a more dependable middle-of-the-rotation arm. Conor Liguori is a freelance writer with The Sporting News.
